corpus_name: Compound Zero Incident Pattern Reference Corpus
scope_note: Small, source-attributed prototype corpus. Pattern summaries and review prompts are project-authored; they are not quotations, legal advice, site procedures, or a substitute for licensed standards.
licensing_note: Only public reference metadata and project-authored summaries are stored. The paid normative text of OISD standards is not bundled.

patterns.title: Ignition-source work overlapping loss of extraction
patterns.pattern_summary: A permit authorises ignition-source work while ventilation or extraction is impaired and flammable-gas indicators are rising. Individually sub-threshold readings can become material when an ignition source, barrier loss, and people exposure overlap.
review_prompts: Pause and route the permit for competent human review.
Verify the site-approved gas-test evidence and extraction status.
Keep shutdown, isolation, and evacuation decisions with authorised site roles.

patterns.title: Confined-space occupancy with deteriorating atmosphere
patterns.pattern_summary: People are observed in or near a confined-space work zone while oxygen or hazardous-atmosphere indicators deteriorate, gas-test evidence is stale or absent, or egress/attendant evidence is incomplete.
review_prompts: Escalate to the competent person and area authority for manual review.
Verify atmosphere-test, ingress-prevention, egress, and attendant evidence against the approved site procedure.
Do not infer a safe entry condition from this prototype.

patterns.title: Simultaneous permits crossing a shift handover
patterns.pattern_summary: Two or more active permits affect the same zone or energy boundary during a shift handover. Status assumptions can diverge when permit, isolation, maintenance, and operating records are transferred separately.
review_prompts: Require the incoming and outgoing authorised roles to reconcile active work and isolations.
Surface conflicting timestamps and evidence without inventing a compliance conclusion.
Route any permit suspension or plant action through site authority.

patterns.title: Blocked egress or emergency access during elevated risk
patterns.pattern_summary: Privacy-preserving vision metadata indicates a blocked egress or emergency-access route while process risk is elevated. The observation is a prompt for immediate human verification, not proof that a statutory requirement is breached.
review_prompts: Dispatch an authorised person to verify the route and preserve observation metadata.
Use the approved emergency plan for any operational response.
Record the human finding and closure evidence.

patterns.title: High-energy steelmaking task followed by explosion and fire
patterns.pattern_summary: A severe explosion and fire during a steel-melting-shop casting operation caused multiple deaths and injuries. Treat it as a reminder to connect process state, work activity, people exposure, evidence preservation, and independent investigation; the public release does not establish a reusable root-cause model.
review_prompts: Preserve time-aligned process, permit, maintenance, and occupancy evidence.
Distinguish confirmed public facts from preliminary or inferred causes.
Do not transfer this event's causal assumptions to another site without investigation.
